title: The Kin of the Changed
text: Shapes in the mist, too tall and too thin, with joints in the wrong places. They come out of the grey and greet one of you like family, arms wide. They know a name that person has not used in a long time.

options.label: The Changed among you goes to their kin, drawn by the name they have not heard in so long.

outcomes.text: They are kind in their way. They give a gift for the road, though they hold on a little too long.
They want them to stay. They do not ask twice.

options.label: Drive them back into the mist. They are no kin of yours.

outcomes.text: Hurt, they go back into the mist, calling softly. Afterward the mist feels colder.

options.label: Hide until they pass, and do not answer to any name.

outcomes.text: As they pass, they call a name. It is the Leader's, and the Leader hears it in every quiet moment after.
